subject: Order form — invoice sequencing, tax evidence, and min-commit tranche plan
messages:
From: Procurement Team <procurement@glaciertech.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: GlacierTech CFO <cfo@glaciertech.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Order form — invoice sequencing & tax evidence request

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo last week — GlacierTech is excited to move forward. Before we get the signature path started, finance needs confirmation on three items for the Order Form and associated PO: 

1) Invoice sequencing: GlacierTech is a multi-entity buyer — we need to confirm whether Redwood will issue a single consolidated invoice to GlacierTech US (our parent) or split invoices to GlacierTech US and GlacierTech EU (entity-level billing). Our PO will reference the billing instructions we send.

2) Taxes & evidence: for EU invoices we require VAT registration evidence from vendor or a statement of VAT responsibility. For US invoices we may need a W-9 or W-8 (TBD by our tax team). Can you confirm what documents Redwood can provide and the expected timing?

3) Minimum commit proration: the draft order form shows a 12-month term with a staged commit (40/30/30). We need an example of invoice cadence and proration treatment if the contract starts mid-month or if GlacierTech requests entity reallocation after quarter close.

Attached: GlacierTech_PO_789.pdf (PO draft).

Would you and your billing lead be able to propose an invoice flow and a short list of documents we can share with our AP team? Hoping to get this clarified before we send for signature next week.

Best,
Ethan Cole
Procurement Lead, GlacierTech
procurement@glaciertech.com

--
Attachment: GlacierTech_PO_789.pdf (application/pdf, 128KB)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Procurement Team <procurement@glaciertech.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T12:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Order form — invoice sequencing & tax evidence request

Thanks Ethan — great questions. Looping in Kimberly (billing) and Ben (acct exec) to propose the operational path. High-level answers below; we'll follow with a redlined order form showing the invoice split and sample invoices.

1) Invoice sequencing: We can support both approaches. For your scenario we recommend entity-level invoices (US + EU) to keep tax/residency clean. Each invoice will reference the PO number you provided and the related Order Form line items that apply to that entity.

2) Taxes & evidence: Redwood can provide:
- US: completed W-9 (for GlacierTech US) OR W-8 if requested for international withholding.
- EU: VAT registration (company VAT ID) and a vendor declaration for EU VAT handling.
We will attach a short vendor tax pack and can provide a pre-filled billing-entity matrix for your AP team.

3) Min-commit proration & tranches: For a staged commit we typically invoice the committed amount per tranche on the tranche start date. If start date is mid-month we prorate the first invoice to the remaining days in the billing period and then invoice full tranches thereafter. If you reallocate usage across entities after quarter close, we will apply a credit/memo on the subsequent invoice to reconcile the difference (we'll show a worked example).

Action items: Kimberly will attach a worked invoice example and a redline of the Order Form that sets invoice recipient per entity + PO mapping. Ben — please confirm the pricing schedule (final SKU/units) so we lock the amounts in the OF.

Attaching: redline_orderform_v3.pdf (contains invoice entity table).

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Senior Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com

--
Attachment: redline_orderform_v3.pdf (application/pdf, 340KB)

From: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@glaciertech.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: GlacierTech CFO <cfo@glaciertech.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T10:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Order form — invoice sequencing & tax evidence request

Mina — thanks, that helps. A couple of clarifying points from our tax team:

• For EU VAT: will Redwood accept GlacierTech EU as the invoiced party and treat Redwood as the supplier liable for VAT? Or do we need to provide reciprocal VAT IDs and have VAT show on the EU invoice? Our preference is to have VAT charged where applicable with clear VAT IDs shown on the invoice.

• For credits/adjustments: if we reallocate 25% of the usage from the US entity to the EU entity after quarter close, will Redwood issue both a credit memo to the US invoice and a supplementary invoice to EU in the same billing run, or will that be split across runs? Our AP team prefers consolidated adjustments per billing cycle to minimize reconciliation work.

Also — can you share the MSA redline that legal will review? We want to ensure there are no cross-entity indemnities that block our entity-level billing approach.

Ethan

--
(Quoted earlier message)
> Thanks again for the demo last week — GlacierTech is excited to move forward. Before we get the signature path started, finance needs confirmation on three items for the Order Form and associated PO...

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@glaciertech.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-03T16:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Order form — invoice sequencing & tax evidence request

Ethan — appreciate the follow-ups. Quick operational runbook below and next steps to get you everything your AP and Tax teams need.

Operational runbook (summary):
- Billing entities: Redwood will issue separate invoices per entity (US / EU) as you requested. Each invoice will: reference the GlacierTech PO, show the applicable VAT ID (where VAT is charged), and include a line-item reference to the Order Form SKU(s).
- VAT handling: Redwood will populate VAT IDs and charge VAT on EU invoices when required by law. If GlacierTech prefers reverse-charge, we can support that but will need a signed declaration from GlacierTech EU confirming reverse-charge treatment.
- Credits/adjustments: Any mid-cycle reallocation will be reflected in the next monthly billing run as a consolidated adjustment (credit to original entity + supplemental invoice to receiving entity).
- Proration: First invoice prorated to days remaining in the billing period; subsequent tranche invoices will bill the full tranche amount at tranche start.

Attachments and links:
- Attached: billing-entity-matrix.xlsx (worked example with three scenarios: on-time start, mid-month start, post-quarter reallocation).
- Attached: MSA_redline_for_legal.docx (we removed cross-entity indemnity language that previously caused hangups).
- DocuSign: https://docusign.com/rdw/GL-3721/orderform (order form + MSA package queued).

Next steps:
1) Ethan: confirm whether GlacierTech wants Redwood to charge VAT or use reverse-charge (legal/tax confirmation).
2) Ethan: confirm final pricing SKUs with Ben so we lock amounts in the redline and DocuSign packet.
3) Kimberly: will drop the W-9 and vendor VAT pack into the Drive folder and confirm with finance by EOD tomorrow.

If that looks good, Ben — please confirm pricing and we'll move the DocuSign packet to signature.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Cloud Billing Operations | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
